verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS documentation platform that stores assistant conversations, search queries and analytics. The evidence pack, however, has no documentation of retention settings, deletion workflows or data-purge APIs. Self-hosting and a vague 'Enterprise security & legal' pricing line are adjacent at best and do not show user-controllable retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
